QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Missing You
QuestInfo.1: Dunas's will has roused the monster. If it escapes #m802000101#, it could destroy Zipangu. Use all your power to stop it.
QuestInfo.2: Ashray, one of Zipangu's three Guardians, sacrificed herself to contain the energy of the apocalyptic wave. She passed her time-traveling powers to Asia, giving her a chance to write a different history. With no faith in Asia's chances, Ashray's lover and fellow guardian Dunas decided instead to hasten the apocalypse, believing that she wouldn't sacrifice herself if there were nothing left to save. In response, Asia fought with Dunas and sealed his soul in a monster, blocking his powers of reincarnation.
